content: परिकर्मन् {%m.%} A servant. --{%n.%} .²1 Painting or perfuming the body, personal decoration, dressing, toilet; कृताचारपरिकर्माणम् <ls>Ś. 2</ls>. .²2 Painting or dyeing the foot; असमाप्ते परिकर्मणि स्मृतः <ls>Ku. 4. 19</ls>. .²3 Preparation. .²4 Worship, adoration; अविक्लमस्ते परिकर्मणि स्थितः <ls>Bhāg. 2. 9. 29</ls>. .²5 (In Yoga <ab>phil.</ab>) Purifying, a means of purifying the mind; मैत्र्यादिचित्तपरिकर्मविदो विधाय क्लेशप्रहाण-मिह लब्धसबीजयोगाः <ls>Śi. 4. 55</ls> (see <ls>Malli.</ls> thereon). .²6 An arithmetical operation (of which there are 8 divisions).
